item.description: Police in Idaho are hailing an armed citizen a hero for distracting a gunman who opened fire outside an In-and-Out in Twin Falls, helping save lives. item.description: Congressman Max Miller (R-Ohio) is doubling down on his reelection bid, defending himself from claims of domestic violence and child abuse by his ex-wife.
